info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Payments Payments Void-v5-spec
info.description: The Void Payments API allows for the cancellation of specific payment transactions that have been previously initiated. This operation is crucial for businesses aiming to rectify errors or prevent further processing of payments. Users, such as finance teams or payment processors, can leverage this endpoint to efficiently manage transaction statuses. Through the Void Payments API, organizations can ensure accurate financial reporting and uphold customer satisfaction by managing erroneous transactions effectively.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to void a previously completed payment. By providing the necessary credentials and payment details, you can ensure that a transaction is canceled and funds are returned if applicable.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to void a payment. It should include the necessary parameters for identifying the payment transaction that needs to be voided.

200.description: The void operation was successful and the payment has been canceled.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: A request body for voiding a payment operation. This is typically a description string or identifier related to the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.title: Void Payment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the void operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: Current state of the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the void operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional details about the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Response schema for the void payment operation indicating the result of the request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the void operation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the void operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the void operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the audit trail of the void operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, in milliseconds. A lower value suggests a quicker transaction.
